site.name: Ransu Portfolio
site.tagline: Frontend developer and designer building accessible, content-rich digital experiences.
site.description: A portfolio website for showcasing case-study style projects, experience, and future writing.

about.intro: I design and build web experiences with a bias toward clarity, accessibility, and maintainable systems.
body: My work sits between frontend implementation and visual design. I like translating messy requirements into tidy interfaces and reusable systems.
This portfolio is structured around case studies so each project can explain the context, constraints, decisions, and measurable outcomes behind the final screen.
A blog will live here later. The content model already leaves room for long-form notes, technical writing, and design breakdowns.
principles: Treat accessibility as product quality, not a checklist.
Document decisions so future collaborators and future agents can follow the reasoning.

resume.headline: Frontend Web Developer / Graphic Designer
resume.summary: Frontend web developer and graphic designer with experience in WordPress, React, responsive UI implementation, Figma-to-code work, and ongoing website maintenance.

highlights: Support Elementor v2 and v3 to v4 migrations by setting up global variables and reusable class structures for more consistent styling and easier maintenance.
Build custom WordPress themes and reusable templates for company websites.
Maintain 8+ company websites and 3+ client websites, including updates, security cleanup, spam prevention, audits, and performance work.
Create branding and marketing assets for internal and client use, and prepare websites for SEO handoff and deployment through cPanel and Hostinger.
Developed and maintained client websites across WordPress and React projects.
Translated Figma designs into responsive React interfaces with accessibility in mind.
Contributed to reusable UI patterns and design-system work that made project builds easier to maintain.
Supported delivery workflows using Git, GitHub Actions, Vitest, and Cloudflare.
Improved large-format print workflows through RIP setup, color calibration, and cutting-process cleanup.
Created reusable templates and organized asset libraries to reduce manual revisions across production work.
Troubleshot hardware and software issues across production workstations and print systems.
Designed social media graphics and branded marketing assets for multiple branches.
Worked with branch managers and marketing teams to refine assets and keep campaign visuals consistent.

contact.title: Let’s work on something clear and useful.
contact.body: For portfolio work, contract opportunities, or collaboration, email me directly. I prefer projects where design quality and implementation quality both matter.
contact.availability: Available for freelance, contract, and select full-time opportunities.

projects.title: Design System Refresh
projects.summary: A case study on cleaning up inconsistent UI patterns and aligning design and implementation.
projects.challenge: The product had visual drift, duplicated components, and inconsistent behavior across breakpoints.
approach: Audited components and grouped repeated patterns into a smaller token-based system.
Aligned spacing, typography, and state patterns across the highest-traffic flows.
Documented usage notes so future work could extend the system instead of bypassing it.
outcome: Reduced visual inconsistency in core journeys.
Made future page work faster by establishing reusable building blocks.
Improved handoff between design and development.

projects.title: Content-First Portfolio Rebuild
projects.summary: A personal site rebuild focused on stronger project storytelling, clearer structure, and better machine readability.
projects.challenge: The older portfolio showed visuals but not enough context, which made it harder for recruiters, collaborators, and AI tools to understand the work.
approach: Shifted from gallery-style presentation to case-study style narratives.
Created markdown mirrors, llms.txt resources, and structured metadata for machine access.
Left room in the information architecture for a future writing section.
outcome: Clearer project framing for hiring and client conversations.
Better discoverability for both humans and agents.
A maintainable base for future blog content.

projects.title: WordPress Performance Audit
projects.summary: A performance and UX cleanup effort for a content-heavy website.
projects.challenge: The site suffered from heavy theme code, layout inconsistencies, and weak mobile navigation.
approach: Removed dead styles and narrowed CSS to the components actually in use.
Fixed responsive navigation behavior and simplified key templates.
Prioritized readable content blocks and lighter page structure.
outcome: Reduced styling debt in critical templates.
Created a cleaner base for future content work.
